facts.value: The Unibator is understood as an 'incubator for innovation' at Goethe University. It supports students, staff, and alumni from all disciplines in implementing scientific findings and associated business ideas into market-ready products and services. Founders go through an 18-month startup program with the aim of developing a validated and scalable business model.

facts.value: The AndersGründer project at the Social Impact Lab Frankfurt supports startups in founding their social enterprises, offering coaching, qualification, co-working, and access to relevant networks.

facts.value: Universities in the FrankfurtRheinMain region have pooled their activities and competences in a central internet portal to support startup initiatives from the academic environment. This portal provides information for interested students, early-stage startups, or growth-stage startups on offers available at various universities.
